<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>！<ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>、<ruby>智<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>慧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>感<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby>、<ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>！”

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>形<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>状<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>豹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>熊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>狮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>龙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>夸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuā</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>任<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>睛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jinɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>焰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>戴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>冠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>冕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>字<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>穿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuān</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>溅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>骑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>穿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuān</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>细<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby>，<ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。
